svg.title: Vibe2Prod — how the agents work together
svg.desc: An approver starts a run from the dashboard. Four ADK agents run in sequence — CodeGuard, Architect + Critic, IaC + Cost, Deploy + Audit — each calling Gemini on Vertex AI, streaming events to Firestore, and pausing at a human approval gate. The run ends with a production-ready app on Cloud Run and a readiness score.
svg.text: How the agents work together — one run, four stages, a human gate between each
every thought · tool call · result → streamed live

g.text: Approver clicks Start run → the dashboard launches the first agent job on Cloud Run
Stage 1 · CodeGuard — 4 scanners run, Gemini reads every file & fixes it, the PR is opened
Stage 2 · Architect drafts the GCP design doc; the Critic reviews it, up to 3 rounds
Stage 3 · IaC writes Terraform, validates & plans it, prices it from the Billing Catalog
Stage 4 · Deploy builds the image, applies Terraform, probes the live app, scores readiness
✓ Run succeeded — production-ready on Cloud Run · readiness score 94 / 100
